question: What is the name of our country? 🇮🇳
explanation: Great job! We live in India, and we are all proud Indians! 🇮🇳
hint: Our flag has Saffron, White, and Green colors.

question: People living in India are called? 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
explanation: Awesome! Everyone who belongs to India is an Indian! 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
hint: It sounds like the name of our country.

question: What is the top color of our flag? 🧡
explanation: Super! The top band of our flag is Saffron orange! 🧡
hint: It looks like a bright orange color.

question: What is the middle color of our flag? 🤍
explanation: Excellent! The middle band is bright White for peace! 🤍
hint: It is the color of milk.

question: What is the bottom color of our flag? 💚
explanation: Brilliant! The bottom color is Green like beautiful trees! 💚
hint: It is the color of fresh grass.

question: What is in the middle of our flag? ☸️
explanation: Great job! The Ashoka Chakra is a wheel in the middle! ☸️
hint: It is round and has spokes.

question: What color is the wheel in our flag? 💙
explanation: Awesome! The Chakra in the middle is a lovely Navy Blue! 💙
hint: It is the color of the deep sky.

question: How do we stand for the National Anthem? 🧍
explanation: Super! We show respect by standing still and straight! 🧍
hint: We stand very still.

question: What is our National Bird? 🦚
explanation: Excellent! The beautiful Peacock is the national bird of India! 🦚
hint: It dances in the rain with pretty feathers.

question: What is our National Animal? 🐅
explanation: Brilliant! The strong Tiger is our national animal! 🐅
hint: It has black stripes on its body.

question: What is our National Flower? 🪷
explanation: Great job! The lovely pink Lotus is our national flower! 🪷
hint: It grows in the water.

question: What is our National Fruit? 🥭
explanation: Awesome! The sweet and juicy Mango is our national fruit! 🥭
hint: It is yellow and very sweet.

question: How should we feel about our country? ❤️
explanation: Super! We love India with all our hearts! ❤️
hint: We give it a lot of hugs and care.

question: We speak different languages, but we are... 🤝
explanation: Excellent! All Indians are united like one big happy family! 🤝
hint: We are all together.

question: How do we live together in India? 🥰
explanation: Brilliant! We care for everyone and live with lots of love! 🥰
hint: We share smiles and hugs.

question: What do we do with our national flag? 🫡
explanation: Great job! We salute and show respect to the Tiranga! 🫡
hint: We salute it with pride.

question: Good Indians always keep their country... 🧹
explanation: Awesome! A clean India is a beautiful India! ✨
hint: We use a broom and dustbin.

question: Where should we throw our garbage? 🗑️
explanation: Super! Good citizens always use the dustbin for trash! 🗑️
hint: It is a bin for waste.

question: What should good citizens plant? 🌱
explanation: Excellent! Planting trees makes our country green and fresh! 🌱
hint: They have green leaves and give us air.

question: When we meet each other, we say... 🙏
explanation: Brilliant! Namaste is a beautiful way to say hello in India! 🙏
hint: We join our hands together.

question: What do we celebrate together? 🎉
explanation: Great job! We enjoy lots of bright and fun festivals together! 🎉
hint: Diwali and Eid are examples.

question: Who protects our beautiful country? 💂‍♂️
explanation: Awesome! Brave soldiers keep all Indians safe and happy! 💂
hint: They wear uniforms and guard the borders.

question: Our Indian flag is also called... 🇮🇳
explanation: Super! Tiranga means it has three lovely colors! 🇮🇳
hint: It means 'three colors'.

question: Tiranga means how many colors? 🎨
explanation: Excellent! 'Ti' means three and 'ranga' means colors! 🎨
hint: Count the main bands on the flag.

question: What does the white color in the flag mean? 🕊️
explanation: Brilliant! White color tells us to live peacefully and happily! 🤍
hint: It means being calm and friendly.

question: What does the green color mean? 🌿
explanation: Great job! Green shows our land is full of life and plants! 💚
hint: It looks like farms and trees.

question: How do we treat all Indians? 🫂
explanation: Awesome! We are all Indians and we are best friends! 🫂
hint: We play and laugh together.

question: We wear different clothes but we are... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
explanation: Super! Even if we look different, we are all proud Indians! 🇮🇳
hint: We share the same country.

question: India is like a big... 🏠
explanation: Excellent! Everyone in India lives together like a big loving family! 🏠
hint: It is full of mothers, fathers, and children.

question: What do we do at school on Independence Day? 🏫
explanation: Brilliant! We lift our flag high and sing the National Anthem! 🇮🇳
hint: We let the Tiranga fly in the wind.

question: What flies high in the sky? 🚩
explanation: Great job! The beautiful Tiranga flies high up in the wind! 🚩
hint: It has three colors and a wheel.

question: How should we speak to others? 🗣️
explanation: Awesome! Good citizens always use polite and sweet words! 🗣️
hint: Use words like please and thank you.

question: We should always tell the... 😇
explanation: Super! Good Indians are honest and always tell the truth! 😇
hint: We do not lie.

question: A good citizen always likes to... 🤝
explanation: Excellent! Helping friends and family makes us good citizens! 🤝
hint: We give a hand to those in need.

question: Who loves India? ❤️
explanation: Brilliant! Every Indian child loves our beautiful country! ❤️
hint: All of us.

question: The blue wheel in the flag has many... ☸️
explanation: Great job! The Ashoka Chakra has 24 lines called spokes! ☸️
hint: They look like lines inside a bicycle wheel.

question: What does the wheel tell us to do? 🚶
explanation: Awesome! The wheel means we should always move forward and grow! ☸️
hint: It means progress and not stopping.

question: What makes India very beautiful? 🌸
explanation: Super! The kind and loving people make India the best! 🌸
hint: It is you, me, and everyone around us.

question: We love to share our... 🍱
explanation: Excellent! Sharing yummy food brings all Indians closer! 🍱
hint: We eat this when we are hungry.

question: We feel proud to be... 🌟
explanation: Brilliant! We are happy and super proud to be Indians! 🌟
hint: It is what people from India are called.

question: We should respect all our... 👴👵
explanation: Great job! We show love and respect to our grandparents and teachers! 👴👵
hint: People who are older than us.

question: How do we sing our National Anthem? 🎶
explanation: Awesome! We sing it proudly with a loud and clear voice! 🎶
hint: So everyone can hear.

question: Our country is very... 🌍
explanation: Super! India is a very big and beautiful country! 🌍
hint: It has lots of cities and people.

question: Which big mountain is in India? 🏔️
explanation: Excellent! The tall and snowy Himalayas are in India! 🏔️
hint: It is covered in white snow.

question: How do Indians celebrate festivals? 🪔
explanation: Brilliant! We light lamps and celebrate with big happy smiles! 🪔
hint: We are very happy and excited.

question: What do we eat on festivals? 🍬
explanation: Great job! We eat tasty ladoos and sweets together! 🍬
hint: They have lots of sugar.

question: When friends fall down, we... 🤝
explanation: Awesome! Good Indians always help their friends when they fall! 🤝
hint: Give them a hand.

question: What binds all Indians together? ❤️
explanation: Super! Love and kindness keep all of us connected! ❤️
hint: It is a warm feeling.

question: We work together to make India... 💪
explanation: Excellent! We all do our best to make our country shine bright! 💪
hint: The best and strongest.

question: At the end of the day, we are all... 🇮🇳
explanation: Brilliant! No matter what, we are all one family of Indians! 🇮🇳
hint: It is the name of our people.
